full_details: At nine the book stood as it was. You are Gaunt. You brought no new line. The lovers are a reading tomorrow at Holywell, and they are not played today. Between the rehearsal and two o'clock you were at home. A bill for the Rose said Crack Me. You read the title and did not cross the river. At two you played Gaunt. You stayed in the house until the end. You did not start a new page at night. You did not count anyone's lines. The one page from October stayed one page.
one_sentence: You rehearsed Gaunt, read the Rose bill Crack Me, and played the afternoon through to the end.
title: Gaunt, and home by dusk
